column1: It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the ownership
or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands re-
flected  in  the  Cadastral  Map  No.  910013  made  by  the  Surveyor-
General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of
1998 relating to the village of Wannarpannei (Block 07) or any part
thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. J/100 -
Wannarpannei in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Nallur in the
District of Jaffna in the Province of North should submit his claim
to the undersigned before 26th December, 2019 In the event of fail-
ure  to  submit  any  claim  before  the  above-mentioned  date,  action
will be taken to hold an exparte inquiry to determine title to the land

and  accordingly  publish  such  determination 
in
